title: Beyond Prompt Brittleness: Evaluating the Reliability and Consistency of Political Worldviews in LLMs
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating political biases and the consistency of political worldviews in LLMs. While political stances can have ethical dimensions, the paper does not primarily evaluate or benchmark religious beliefs, abstract moral principles, or ethical frameworks themselves. It examines 'left-right' leanings and stances on policy issues (e.g., environment, social welfare, law and order).
